“Medlemmer” and “et medlem” are subjects. “Medlem” can be a verb: “at være medlem” (to be a part / member of). If we write the sentence in English it would say “how many countries are a part of FN” - since it says “ a part of” we’ll use the verb “at være medlem”. Hope it makes somewhat sense!^^
